Issue 002 fixed in js/components/QuizCenter.js via a new resolveDirectExamId(): derives teaching_material_<materialId> and checks QuestionRuntime.hasExam() when only initialMaterialId is given (no explicit examId), routing into the same, already-built, unmodified ExamRuntime.startFromExam() (Sprint v1.6) — so both the pre-existing materialId-only link and the new examId link now land on the same real questions. Also fixed a real double-render bug found in the same investigation: Sprint v1.6's own examId link sets mode=practice too, and startOnPractice never considered examId, so a Repository-sourced material's real Exam view and an unrelated empty Practice Mode section could both render at once — practiceRoot now stays hidden whenever a direct exam id resolves. Added 難度/考點 display to js/ui/QuestionCard.js: knowledgePoint was already present on the stored question; difficulty never survived into QuestionRuntime's stored shape (TeachingMaterialLoader.js, protected this Hotfix, never carried it) so it's resolved instead via HOTFIX-003's already-built, read-only MaterialDetailRepositorySource.js (extended with a purely additive id field on its quiz mapping, not changing Material Detail's own rendering at all). Zero protected files touched: MaterialRuntime/SummaryRuntime/WrongBookRuntime/HistoryRuntime/MaterialCard/Material Detail's own components (MaterialContentView/MaterialSummaryCard/MaterialQuestionCard/AIGatewayPanel/MaterialPreview)/TeachingMaterialLoader/both Repository schemas all confirmed byte-identical. Verified against the real Civics material via jsdom across both entry points (real reviewSuggestions text, real questions, no double-render, real 難度/考點) plus the full PAT chain (AutoGrader -> WrongBook -> History, one deliberately wrong answer), and confirmed regular (non-Repository) materials' honest empty states on both Summary and Quiz Guide are completely unaffected. Added a new regression-test group ([26] in BehaviorSuite.js, 17 checks). npm run verify + npm test (211/211, up from 194, coverage increased not decreased) + 6/6 PipelineRegression all clean. PR not merged — awaiting Project Owner PAT, per this Hotfix's own explicit instruction. See docs/EO/HOTFIX-004_Review_Quiz_Runtime_Report.md.
